topic.title: Non-continuous APIC IDs

body.p: The BIOS and OS should not assume the APIC IDs are continuous in the processor package. There will be APIC ID gaps between cores. Factory or BIOS configurations of disabling core and threads can also result in APIC ID gaps.
The unique APIC IDs for each thread can be read from CPUID instruction leaf 1:
CPUID (EAX=1, ECX=0) -> EBX[31:24] = Initial APIC ID
